formulaIdentity.fingerprintMethod: sha256 of packet canonicalInci joined with ', '

formulaIdentity.conflictNotes: 'Hyaluron' maps to Sodium Hyaluronate (14); 'Shea-Fettsäuren' to Butyrospermum Parkii Butter (10). 'Sulfatfrei' is consistent (olefin sulfonate is not a sulfate). No conflict.

cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate by C1: defining anionic Sodium C14-16 Olefin Sulfonate (2, sulfonate type) with prominent buffers Cocamidopropyl Betaine (5) and Sodium Lauroyl Sarcosinate (7, mild anionic); no reinforcing strong anionic. Cocamide MEA (3) is not a route (C3); Coco-Betaine (17) is post-fragrance (C4). No counter-signal creates a realistic neighbor.

conditioningLevel.rationale: One meaningful system plus light routes: Glycol Distearate (6) pearlizing route, Glycerin (4), Shea Butter (10, after Parfum), Hydroxypropyl Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride (19), Polyquaternium-7 (21), Sodium Hyaluronate (14). C2 not met: no prominent silicone and the payload lipid is not prominent (E3). Counter-signal toward high: two cationic polymers plus shea and pearlizer.

excluded: PEG-55 Propylene Glycol Oleate (12): PEG thickener

depositionLoad.rationale: Three converging deposition routes (waxy shea, guar, PQ-7) but all post-fragrance.

persistence.rationale: Shea is a waxy, more substantive lipid (6.4); PQ-7 is a persistent cationic polymer; levels are low.

resetCapacity.rationale: C1 olefin-sulfonate chassis with two buffers.

weightPotential.counterevidence: Every deposition family sits after Parfum (8), the polymers near the end (19, 21); olefin sulfonate is an effective reset.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: Waxy lipid plus two cationic polymers interact into a plausible, bounded residue against ordinary reset.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not low (W2): three distinct families including a waxy payload lipid and Polyquaternium-7 converge; calling it lightweight would understate residue risk. Not high: no silicone, lipid not prominent (no W-RICH), reset not limited.
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: All routes post-fragrance; low levels could make it low (adjacent).
weightPotential.rationale: Moderate: interacting light/moderate routes (6.6 moderate anchor) with ordinary reset.

focusPrimary.counterSignal: Shea and polymers are post-fragrance; '72 Stunden Feuchtigkeit' is a marketing claim not provable from INCI (3.2).
focusPrimary.decisionTrace: 'Feuchtigkeitsauffüllendes' in the exact product name (high); manufacturer repeats moisture/hydration. Formula verdict moisture_supported (humectant cluster + emollient/cationic support). F1 -> moisture. Curl wording is hair_texture, not a focus.
focusPrimary.rationale: moisture by F1/7.2: name-level hydration claim over a moisture_supported formula.

focusSecondary.decisionTrace: Empty default considered; curl definition/'gebändigt' is not a focus value and rides on the same deposition route (F2).

usageRole.decisionTrace: Default regular; no frequency, reset or dandruff trigger.

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: No E2 sensitive/dry scalp claim; application to the scalp is a direction, not positioning (SC1).

dandruffSupport.rationale: No Piroctone Olamine or Climbazole; Salicylic Acid does not qualify.

projection.thicknessRationale: T1 W moderate, C moderate: fine acceptable, normal ideal, coarse acceptable. Ordinary, no T6. T4: W neighbor low would raise fine/keep normal ideal; C neighbor high would raise coarse -> no lower tier, no flag. Curl/texture wording ignored (T2).
projection.scalpTargetRationale: S-ORDINARY way 1: no qualifying E2 claim unit; packet has a manufacturer source -> high (13.8).
projection.cleansingIntensityRationale: I1 moderate -> regular; matches normal bucket; I3 neighbor none.

uncertainties: Weight low vs moderate: W2 lists 'each family late/trace' as a permissible low reason, while waxy shea + PQ-7 argue moderate; resolved toward the heavier band (W3 forbids resolving a balanced boundary lighter at moderate confidence).
